subject: general
question: The Government of India’s capital expenditure has increased nearly 4.2 times from FY18 to FY26 (BE). According to the Economic Survey, this increase has positioned which of the following as a key growth driver?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Infrastructure.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman tabled the Economic Survey 2025-26 in Parliament.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India’s **capital expenditure** has increased nearly **4.2 times**, from ₹2.63 lakh crore in FY18 to **₹11.21 lakh crore in FY26 (BE)**.
 
• The **effective capital expenditure** in FY26 (BE) stands at **₹15.48 lakh crore**.
 
• The Economic Survey notes that this massive increase in expenditure has positioned **infrastructure** as a key growth driver for the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Infrastructure Achievements (Economic Survey 2025-26)__

 
 
• **Highways:** National Highway network grew by about 60% to 1,46,572 km (FY26).
 
• **Railways:** Network reached 69,439 route km; 99.1% electrification achieved by Oct 2025.
 
• **Aviation:** Number of airports increased from 74 in 2014 to 164 in 2025.
 
• **Power:** Installed capacity rose to 509.74 GW; DISCOMs recorded a positive PAT of ₹2,701 crore.
 
 

2b8:T1
